description: Returns the signed-in account's videos, newest first, one page at a time (pass `cursor` from the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true). WHEN: the user asks what they have made, or you need a video from an earlier session. It is the whole library, including videos made in the web app and with products this API cannot create. THIS IS HOW YOU FIND A STORY EPISODE, and every story tool needs its id: a row carries `kind: "story_episode"` and `story_stage` (the `get_video` vocabulary); pass `kind: "story_episode"` to get only those. READ `story_stage`, not just `status`: `frames_review` means WAITING FOR THE USER yet reports `status: "processing"`; `ready_to_render` means the scene videos are done and the final file is not made yet; `rendered` means it is; `starting`, `generating_frames`, `generating_scenes`, `rendering` and `writing_failed` mean what they say. `story_stage` is omitted when the episode has no engine run yet: read that job with `get_video`.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

kind.description: Only videos of this kind: `story_episode` is an AI Video Story episode (the rows the story tools take an id from). Omit for the whole library.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: list_videos
title: List the account's AI videos
